title: Healthcare professionals are requested to fill questionnaire to asses KAP (Knowledge, Attitude & Practice) on safety surveillance practice of medical devices in India
bodyHtml:
NCC-MvPI, IPC seeks your inputs to assess the present readiness of all healthcare professionals including RMPs, Nurses, Pharmacists, Biomedical Engineers, and persons actively involved in the use, testing, store, and purchase of medical devices including in-vitro diagnostics on safety surveillance practice of medical devices in India.

In this regard, you all are requested to provide your valuable response by filling questionnaire by April 30, 2022, using the following link.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdFcz8Mh9JUCziP820kIizeghXhzmH4USkO4bHpRXNU_0JDw/viewform?usp=sf_link (opens in a new tab)

Note: This questionnaire is a part of the research study. The information will be kept strictly confidential and entirely be used for research purposes only.
